question:
In the given figure line l is parallel to m and p is the transversal. Find the measure of the angle 1. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1491cd6590942b22e1bb2c32c4b01a651a63bf14d4014dcd6f28a762a332a318.png]
solution:
Calculation:

⇒ x + 80° = 2x + 10° (Corresponding angles)

⇒ x = 70°

⇒ ∠1 = x + 80°

Substitute x = 70°

⇒ ∠1 = 70° + 80°

⇒ ∠1 = 150°.

∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.
